subject: Malaysia M-52: printing-ink TDS and a 1 kg sample
body:
For SICO's printing-ink review, M-52 is a sulfate-process rutile grade. Its TDS lists printing inks and typical oil absorption of 14 g/100g, measured to ISO 787-5.

Our REACH registration certificate is available for review.

I've attached the M-52 TDS and REACH information for your review.

We can provide a free 1 kg sample.

Shall we arrange a sample for your ink team's evaluation?
